content: 第六关（后）

speaker: Infected Fighter
content: Talulah.

raw: [name="Talulah"] ...Hm? You rarely make that face, friend. What's wrong?
speaker: Talulah
content: ...Hm? You rarely make that face, friend. What's wrong?

speaker: Infected Fighter
content: We've decided.

raw: [name="Infected Fighter"] We're going to stay here.
speaker: Infected Fighter
content: We're going to stay here.

raw: [name="Infected Fighter"] Ah, uh... putting it another way, there are some of us willing to stay here. And some are thinking about getting out of Ursus territory.
speaker: Infected Fighter
content: Ah, uh... putting it another way, there are some of us willing to stay here. And some are thinking about getting out of Ursus territory.

raw: [name="Infected Fighter"] But either way, none of us'll be carrying on heading south with you. We're sorry.
speaker: Infected Fighter
content: But either way, none of us'll be carrying on heading south with you. We're sorry.

speaker: Talulah
content: Alright. I see.

raw: [name="Infected Fighter"] You're not even going to ask for a reason?
speaker: Infected Fighter
content: You're not even going to ask for a reason?

raw: [name="Infected Fighter"] You're the one who taught us, took us all this way up 'til today—
speaker: Infected Fighter
content: You're the one who taught us, took us all this way up 'til today—

raw: [name="Talulah"] And does that mean you have to obey me, keep your life tied to your blade, fight Ursus to your last breath?
speaker: Talulah
content: And does that mean you have to obey me, keep your life tied to your blade, fight Ursus to your last breath?

raw: [name="Talulah"] Because it's never been like that. Never been, friend. You've got the cart and the beast mixed up.
speaker: Talulah
content: Because it's never been like that. Never been, friend. You've got the cart and the beast mixed up.

raw: [name="Infected Fighter"] Ha ha... I guess. That's like you, Talulah, it really is.
speaker: Infected Fighter
content: Ha ha... I guess. That's like you, Talulah, it really is.

raw: [name="Talulah"] I'm not your ruler. And you deserve to have this land, in the first place. Even if filled with corpses, turbulent with bad memories, the tundra is, as it was, your homeland.
speaker: Talulah
content: I'm not your ruler. And you deserve to have this land, in the first place. Even if filled with corpses, turbulent with bad memories, the tundra is, as it was, your homeland.

raw: [name="Talulah"] You're all strong. I'm sure you'll find a way to prevail through it all.
speaker: Talulah
content: You're all strong. I'm sure you'll find a way to prevail through it all.

raw: [name="Talulah"] If you want, I can send you off.
speaker: Talulah
content: If you want, I can send you off.

raw: [name="Infected Fighter"] No, no, don't, really. You should know it wasn't exactly the firmest thing, making this decision, anyhow...
speaker: Infected Fighter
content: No, no, don't, really. You should know it wasn't exactly the firmest thing, making this decision, anyhow...

raw: [name="Infected Fighter"] Ha, thinking about it, I used to be one of your people. I'll be telling my future companions plenty of stories about you.
speaker: Infected Fighter
content: Ha, thinking about it, I used to be one of your people. I'll be telling my future companions plenty of stories about you.

raw: [name="Talulah"] Here's begging for your mercy, then.
speaker: Talulah
content: Here's begging for your mercy, then.

speaker: Distant Shout
content: Talulah, the campfire's up!

raw: [name="Talulah"] Alright, I'll be there in a moment!
speaker: Talulah
content: Alright, I'll be there in a moment!

raw: [name="Talulah"] Friend, will tonight be our last meal together?
speaker: Talulah
content: Friend, will tonight be our last meal together?

raw: [name="Infected Fighter"] Just wait a bit longer... some others'll want to talk with you too, probably. All of them would.
speaker: Infected Fighter
content: Just wait a bit longer... some others'll want to talk with you too, probably. All of them would.

speaker: Talulah
content: Mm.

speaker: Infected Fighter
content: ...Talulah.

raw: [name="Infected Fighter"] How do you guarantee that everyone who stands by your side works with you as one? How do you know betrayal or some other crap isn't headed your way?
speaker: Infected Fighter
content: How do you guarantee that everyone who stands by your side works with you as one? How do you know betrayal or some other crap isn't headed your way?

raw: [name="Infected Fighter"] Uh... no, I guess you obviously have your ways. You're so smart, so strong to boot, and you know so much. A wound here or some bleeding there wouldn't slow your pace down, would it?
speaker: Infected Fighter
content: Uh... no, I guess you obviously have your ways. You're so smart, so strong to boot, and you know so much. A wound here or some bleeding there wouldn't slow your pace down, would it?

raw: [name="Talulah"] ...The praise is one thing, but could you not make me out to be so terrifying?
speaker: Talulah
content: ...The praise is one thing, but could you not make me out to be so terrifying?

raw: [name="Infected Fighter"] Ha ha, don't get us wrong, one or two frustrations wouldn't make us lose our gall. We're no cowards...
speaker: Infected Fighter
content: Ha ha, don't get us wrong, one or two frustrations wouldn't make us lose our gall. We're no cowards...

raw: [name="Infected Fighter"] I just suddenly realized. Actually, maybe not everyone thinks... thinks the same as you, anyway. Yeah.
speaker: Infected Fighter
content: I just suddenly realized. Actually, maybe not everyone thinks... thinks the same as you, anyway. Yeah.

raw: [name="Infected Fighter"] I mean, take me. I was gonna die anyway. I just chose to tag along with you all so I'd be able to eat something, live a few more days of my life.
speaker: Infected Fighter
content: I mean, take me. I was gonna die anyway. I just chose to tag along with you all so I'd be able to eat something, live a few more days of my life.

raw: [name="Infected Fighter"] Moment I ate my own fill, I realized there were actually plenty like me. And I figured it'd be nice if they could eat their fill too...
speaker: Infected Fighter
content: Moment I ate my own fill, I realized there were actually plenty like me. And I figured it'd be nice if they could eat their fill too...

raw: [name="Talulah"] Strength, particularly in goodwill. They're qualities hard to come by.
speaker: Talulah
content: Strength, particularly in goodwill. They're qualities hard to come by.

raw: [name="Infected Fighter"] Yep. Hard, for sure. So it's definitely not everyone who thinks that way.
speaker: Infected Fighter
content: Yep. Hard, for sure. So it's definitely not everyone who thinks that way.

raw: [name="Infected Fighter"] Who can guarantee we'll keep moving on, that we won't meet a crueler end? The old noblemen eliminating us all, implicating the innocent poor and all their children along the way?
speaker: Infected Fighter
content: Who can guarantee we'll keep moving on, that we won't meet a crueler end? The old noblemen eliminating us all, implicating the innocent poor and all their children along the way?

raw: [name="Infected Fighter"] I... it doesn't really matter to me, but when I realize all the other ways it could go, it stresses me out.
speaker: Infected Fighter
content: I... it doesn't really matter to me, but when I realize all the other ways it could go, it stresses me out.

raw: [name="Infected Fighter"] And not to mention that to some people, nothing else matters except their own fill... if the question is just feeding yourself, even I could come up with plenty of ideas, like... ngh.
speaker: Infected Fighter
content: And not to mention that to some people, nothing else matters except their own fill... if the question is just feeding yourself, even I could come up with plenty of ideas, like... ngh.

speaker: Infected Fighter
content: Like selling out.

raw: [name="Infected Fighter"] Selling out what matters to us. Plenty of people are itching to destroy us, and they'd happily let some nobody Infected off to dispatch the remaining rebels. Couldn't be more cost-effective if you tried.
speaker: Infected Fighter
content: Selling out what matters to us. Plenty of people are itching to destroy us, and they'd happily let some nobody Infected off to dispatch the remaining rebels. Couldn't be more cost-effective if you tried.

raw: [name="Infected Fighter"] So I think... seeing that's how things are, we can't leave here now more than ever.
speaker: Infected Fighter
content: So I think... seeing that's how things are, we can't leave here now more than ever.

raw: [name="Infected Fighter"] Talulah, we can't take every single person with us, can we?
speaker: Infected Fighter
content: Talulah, we can't take every single person with us, can we?

speaker: Talulah
content: I have to... concede that.

raw: [name="Infected Fighter"] That being the case, before we head all the way south and win all that goodness you talked about... uh, what about the tundra? What about the Infected left behind on it?
speaker: Infected Fighter
content: That being the case, before we head all the way south and win all that goodness you talked about... uh, what about the tundra? What about the Infected left behind on it?

raw: [name="Infected Fighter"] Not just the tundra, really... the world's so vast, and to say it straight, some people are just thinking of taking the chance to leave this place.
speaker: Infected Fighter
content: Not just the tundra, really... the world's so vast, and to say it straight, some people are just thinking of taking the chance to leave this place.

raw: [name="Infected Fighter"] Finding like-minded folk elsewhere in hardship and distress, seeing if other places... might have a niche in them for the Infected.
speaker: Infected Fighter
content: Finding like-minded folk elsewhere in hardship and distress, seeing if other places... might have a niche in them for the Infected.

raw: [name="Infected Fighter"] Some people might look at it that way.
speaker: Infected Fighter
content: Some people might look at it that way.

speaker: Talulah
content: You...

raw: [name="Talulah"] Your seeing things this way honestly makes me really... happy.
speaker: Talulah
content: Your seeing things this way honestly makes me really... happy.

raw: [name="Infected Fighter"] Uh... feels like the why would fly over my head, so I'm just gonna not ask...
speaker: Infected Fighter
content: Uh... feels like the why would fly over my head, so I'm just gonna not ask...

raw: [name="Infected Fighter"] C—circling back, uh... does the fact we're leaving at such a critical point mean we'll be considered deserters? I don't really get all that too well, which is why I came to talk to you.
speaker: Infected Fighter
content: C—circling back, uh... does the fact we're leaving at such a critical point mean we'll be considered deserters? I don't really get all that too well, which is why I came to talk to you.

speaker: Talulah
content: *chuckle* Well, of course not.

raw: [name="Talulah"] Be it Talulah, the Guerrillas, so on, they're all 'names' and nothing more.
speaker: Talulah
content: Be it Talulah, the Guerrillas, so on, they're all 'names' and nothing more.

raw: [name="Talulah"] You carry what lies beneath your names... your mindsets, spirits. You carry that sublime fire of resistance, scattering it across this world's every part. For all this, where's the need to fault yourself?
speaker: Talulah
content: You carry what lies beneath your names... your mindsets, spirits. You carry that sublime fire of resistance, scattering it across this world's every part. For all this, where's the need to fault yourself?

speaker: Infected Fighter
content: Alright!

raw: [name="Infected Fighter"] Frankly, I only sort of get it still, but with those words coming from you, Talulah, that puts me at ease.
speaker: Infected Fighter
content: Frankly, I only sort of get it still, but with those words coming from you, Talulah, that puts me at ease.

speaker: Talulah
content: Be at ease, really.

raw: [name="Talulah"] Alright... I can't let the hunters' efforts go to waste. The knack you all have for laying out traps really opens my eyes.
speaker: Talulah
content: Alright... I can't let the hunters' efforts go to waste. The knack you all have for laying out traps really opens my eyes.

raw: [name="Infected Fighter"] I'll miss the days I was able to eat like this. Talulah, we'll travel to every corner of this land.
speaker: Infected Fighter
content: I'll miss the days I was able to eat like this. Talulah, we'll travel to every corner of this land.

raw: [name="Infected Fighter"] Hey, everyone over here! Food's ready!
speaker: Infected Fighter
content: Hey, everyone over here! Food's ready!
